# Contributing

Thank you for helping keep the product review page up to date.

## Quick workflow

1. Edit `index.html` (and/or upload images to `images/`)
2. Commit directly to `main`
3. Check the live site after ~2 minutes: https://lauras-pa.github.io/freeprints-gifts-product-review/

See [README.md](../README.md) for detailed editing instructions.

## Tips

- Make one logical change per commit when possible (easier to undo)
- Use descriptive commit messages, e.g. "Update pillow case comps" or "Add light up frame P&L"
- To undo a mistake: open the file on GitHub → **History** → select a previous version → **Revert**
